chunks: As for what ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar narrated from his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام, he said:

I asked him about a man who forgot the obligatory tawaf until he returned to his land and had relations with women. What should he do? He said: He should send a sacrificial offering; if he omitted it during hajj, he should send it in hajj, and if he omitted it during ʿumrah, he should send it in ʿumrah, and he should appoint someone to perform on his behalf what he omitted of his tawaf.

The correct way regarding this report is that we understand it to refer to Tawaf al-Nisa', because whoever omits Tawaf al-Nisa' forgetfully may appoint another in his place to perform his tawaf, and that is not permissible in the tawaf of hajj. This is indicated by what follows.

key_terms.بِهَدْيٍ: a sacrificial offering to be sent
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf that was left undone
key_terms.طَوَافِ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf connected to the permissibility of marital relations
key_terms.وَوَاقَعَ النِّسَاءَ: he engaged in sexual relations with women
key_terms.يَسْتَنِيبَ غَيْرَهُ: to appoint another person as one's representative

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets Tawaf al-Nisa' and returns home before remembering?
ai.summary: This report discusses the ruling for someone who forgot an obligatory tawaf and only remembered after returning home and engaging in marital relations. The text states that a sacrificial offering must be sent and a representative appointed to complete the missed tawaf, while the concluding note clarifies that this ruling is to be understood as applying to Tawaf al-Nisa', not the tawaf of hajj.
